description: Ranked vendors for a buying need (e.g. "payroll for a 10-person startup in Ireland"): name, profile URL, Proven Score, band, one-line description, and whether a public or network offer exists.

category.description: Optional group name, e.g. "Payroll & HR". Restricts results to that group.

country.description: Optional: where the buyer company is registered, as a country name or ISO code (e.g. Ireland, US, GB). Leaves out vendors whose own website says they are not available there; vendors with no availability data are kept (check available_countries). Also boosts vendors headquartered there.

need.description: What the buyer needs, in plain words.

stage.description: Optional buyer stage, e.g. seed, series a, growth, enterprise. Boosts, does not filter.

name: find_vendors
title: Find vendors for a need
